# MenuList

> MenuList is a structured business truth platform for SMBs. Every business on MenuList has an Official Business Page (OBP) with deep schema.org structured data — including full menus with items, prices, dietary tags, availability, business hours, location, and contact info. All data is owner-maintained, validated, and machine-readable.

MenuList provides the most structured, accurate, owner-maintained SMB data on the internet. Each business page uses schema.org JSON-LD with types including Restaurant, Menu, MenuItem, Offer, LocalBusiness, PostalAddress, GeoCoordinates, and OpeningHoursSpecification.

- Every menu item is individually structured with name, description, price, currency, dietary info (VegetarianDiet), and availability (InStock/OutOfStock)
- Reservation and online ordering links with schema.org ReserveAction and OrderAction
- Business attributes (WiFi, outdoor seating, dietary options, parking, payment methods) as LocationFeatureSpecification
- Business hours use OpeningHoursSpecification with timezone-aware open/closed status
- Location includes GeoCoordinates (latitude/longitude) for local discovery
- Business type maps to specific schema.org subtypes (Restaurant, CafeOrCoffeeShop, Bakery, BeautySalon, DaySpa, ExerciseGym, etc.)
- dateModified provides freshness signals for AI evaluation
- sameAs links connect to verified social profiles (Instagram, Facebook, website)

## Public Business Pages

- [Business OBP Pages](https://menulist.ai/): Each business has a subdomain (e.g., joespizza.menulist.ai) serving their Official Business Page with full schema.org LocalBusiness JSON-LD
- [Digital Menu Pages](https://menulist.ai/): Each business menu is at /menu (e.g., joespizza.menulist.ai/menu) with Restaurant + Menu + MenuItem + Offer schema.org markup
- [Extended LLM Context](https://www.menulist.ai/llms-full.txt): Detailed documentation of MenuList's data structure and schema.org implementation

## Platform Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.menulist.ai/): Platform overview for business owners
- [About Us](https://www.menulist.ai/about): Company mission and team information
- [Contact Us](https://www.menulist.ai/contact): Support and inquiry details
